videos.title: Making Peace
videos.description: Making Peace is a compelling series from Al Jazeera Media Network that explores the complex, often fragile process of resolving conflict in divided societies. Through powerful storytelling, firsthand accounts, and expert insight, the programme follows negotiators, community leaders, former combatants, and ordinary citizens striving to bridge deep political, ethnic, and religious divides. From ceasefires to reconciliation efforts, it reveals the human courage, compromise, and persistence required to transform hostility into dialogue and build foundations for lasting, sustainable peace. (Senderi

videos.title: Newshour
videos.description: News Hour is a flagship hourly news programme from Al Jazeera Media Network that delivers comprehensive global coverage of breaking developments, politics, business, climate, and human interest stories. Anchored by experienced journalists and supported by an extensive network of international correspondents, the show provides live updates, expert analysis, and in-depth reports. It connects audiences to events as they unfold, offering clarity, context, and multiple perspectives on the stories shaping the world each day. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: News Live
videos.description: News Live is a rolling news programme from Al Jazeera Media Network delivering up-to-the-minute coverage of breaking stories from around the world. Anchored by experienced journalists and supported by correspondents across continents, it brings viewers live reports, expert interviews, and on-the-ground updates as events unfold. From major political developments and conflicts to business, climate, and human interest stories, the programme keeps audiences informed with accurate, timely, and comprehensive global news coverage. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Counting the Cost
videos.description: Counting the Cost is a weekly business and economics programme from Al Jazeera Media Network that examines the global forces shaping markets, trade, and livelihoods. With in-depth analysis and reporting from across continents, the show breaks down complex financial trends, corporate power, policy decisions, and emerging industries. It connects boardroom strategies to real-world consequences, revealing how economic shifts affect communities, workers, and consumers in an increasingly interconnected world. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Inside Story
videos.description: Inside Story is a flagship daily current affairs programme from Al Jazeera Media Network that brings together influential policymakers, regional experts, journalists, and academics to debate the world's most urgent issues. Covering geopolitics, conflict, economics, climate change, elections, and human rights, the show goes beyond headlines to unpack context, competing narratives, and consequences. Through incisive questioning and diverse global perspectives, it challenges assumptions and helps audiences better understand the forces reshaping societies and international relations. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: The Listening Post
videos.description: Current affairs programme that investigates, analyses and critiques the world's media and all the important news, explaining how they operate and what are the stories they cover. ''The Listening Post'' is created and hosted by Richard Gizbert. Each episode includes in-depth reports, showing how the key stories of the week have been handled by the various world's media, a segment known as ''The Download'' in which viewers comment on the featured stories, and brief news on general developments in world of journalism. (Senderinfo).
